newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Banks steady, Solidere mixed in Beirut.

text.p: Bank shares held steady on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Friday as Audi shares traded at $16.125 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce shares at $12.
Solidere A shares were unchanged from Thursday's $10.75 while B shares fell to $11 from $11.125.
Turnover in Audi fell to 21,570 shares from 51,000, and a total of 10,000 BLC shares traded on the market, unchanged from a day earlier.

Also traded on the BSE were 10,000 shares of tile manufacturer Uniceramic at $1.5 for the first time since June when they last traded at $3.25. In November, the BSE suspended the pricing of the shares after the company increased its capital.
Kamil Saade, Financial Manager at Uniceramic told Reuters the firm's total equity of six billion pounds was increased to 15 billion late last year.

"The increase came from reserves after the revaluation of fixed assets. The company's new total equity of 15 billion pounds was divided by the existing number of shares and the new share price was obtained," he added.
Market sources said Uniceramic shares were trading on the grey market at $1.33 after the capital increase.
There was no trade in the three other firms listed on the BSE: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, and Eternit.
Total BSE turnover was 89,015 shares compared with 123,066 shares and value was $998,123 against $1,619,701.
The BLOM stock index fell 0.46 percent to 918.26 and the LISPI stock index fell 0.12 percent to 81.59.
